name: drawguess-realtime
description: Real-time multiplayer drawing and guessing game

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @drawguess/shared && concurrently -n shared,server,web -c magenta,blue,green "npm run dev -w @drawguess/shared" "npm run dev -w @drawguess/server" "npm run dev -w @drawguess/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @drawguess/shared && npm run build -w @drawguess/server && npm run build -w @drawguess/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @drawguess/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @drawguess/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
